mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BATCH_EXEC_ITEM_LOG ( EXEC_ID, BATCH_ID, BASE_DT, MKT_CD, STK_CD, STK_NM, ITEM_STATUS, ERROR_MSG, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{execId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{baseDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{mktCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stkCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stkNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{itemStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errorMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT STK_CD AS stkCd, STK_NM AS stkNm, MKT_CD AS mktCd FROM TB_BATCH_EXEC_ITEM_LOG WHERE EXEC_ID = ( SELECT EXEC_ID FROM ( SELECT EXEC_ID FROM TB_BATCH_EXEC_LOG WHERE BATCH_ID = #{sourceBatchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BASE_DT = TO_DATE(#{baseDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY START_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AND ITEM_STATUS = 'FAIL' ORDER BY STK_CD ASC
